rationale: With only 15 minutes remaining in the session and the stock trading at the extreme top of its daily range (97.5% position), the risk-to-reward ratio for a long entry is poor due to the proximity of the daily high and the likelihood of profit-taking into the close. Given the limited time horizon and the lack of a clear catalyst, staying flat is the most prudent approach.
